title: ESP32-S3 DevKit
prompt: an ESP32-S3 DevKit board and a phone: plug into UART, upload a sketch, connect to Wi-Fi and open its web page on the phone, then put it in deep sleep; see-through labels the two-core chip, antenna, USB-UART bridge, regulator, RGB LED and buttons
blurb: Plug an ESP32-S3 DevKit into its UART port, flash a sketch through the USB-UART bridge, join Wi-Fi and set its RGB LED from a phone, then watch everything but the RTC timer power down in deep sleep.
